description: Ask in plain words whether a payment can move on tokenised deposits, e.g. 'can a USD payment reach DBS Singapore 24/7 on tokenised deposits from a US bank?'. Returns JSON: whether a live tokenised route is shown by public sources (or "not enough evidence yet"), which networks (Kinexys by J.P. Morgan, DBS Token Services, Partior, the Swift shared ledger) and the links between them, operating hours and published downtime (e.g. Kinexys pauses moves between deposit and blockchain accounts on Saturdays 15:00 to 18:00 US Eastern), the banks on those networks, the Swift correspondent route as the alternative, sources with check dates, and a signed record (verify at POST https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/attestations/verify). Network membership is not eligibility: the payer's bank confirms access. Free answer; USD 0.25 per call by x402 in USDC on Base for agents that pay per call. Same check: GET https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/tokenised-routes?q=... SwapEazi never sends, holds or settles money.

q.description: The payment in plain words: currency, where it starts (bank or country) and where it should land (bank or country), and whether it must move 24/7.
